text:
María Gomez: Hi finance — quick question. I paid a porter at Hotel Alvear in BA cash (ARS 2,500) when leaving this morning. No printed receipt, porter gave a handwritten note with amount and date. Can I submit for reimbursement?
Alex K.: Hey María — yes we can reimburse cash tips under 'incidental expenses' but need manager approval + proof. Do you have the hotel folio or any photo of the note?
María Gomez: I have a photo of the note and the folio page that shows the room charge (folio doesn't itemize the porter tip). Photo links: https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/boa_note.jpg, https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/boa_folio.jpg
Alex K.: Perfect. Two things: 1) manager sign-off in the expense form comment, 2) attach both images. Also tell us whether you want reimbursement in USD or reimbursed in ARS (we reimburse in home currency by default unless you request otherwise).
María Gomez: Prefer USD reimbursement. What FX rate do we use?
Finance-Bot: Please use the corporate FX policy: convert using the daily mid-market rate on the date of purchase and attach a screenshot of the rate source (xe.com, oanda, or Google). Example: "Expense currency: ARS, Converted currency: USD, FX source: XE, Rate date: 2026-03-18"
Liz M. (Manager): I approve this reimbursement up to USD 20 for incidental porter tip. Please include the photos and put my name in the approval field. :thumbsup:
Alex K.: Noted — manager approval captured. María, when you submit select: Expense type = "Incidental - Travel (Tip)", Amount = "ARS 2,500", Convert to USD using XE on 2026-03-18, Add manager comment: "Liz M. approved". Also include the policy code reference: FIN-EXP-TRV-003.
María Gomez: Done — submitted the expense, attached both photos and link to XE screenshot. Submission ID 987654.
Finance-Bot: Expense 987654 received. Status: Pending Manager Approval. (automated)
Alex K.: I'll review supporting docs and approve payout in next batch if everything looks good. FYI: if the hotel folio had itemized porter service we would require that, but handwritten note + folio screenshot + manager approval is acceptable for tips under USD 50 per policy.
Jordan C. (Legal): Quick note — for Argentina, if the reimbursement is > USD 100 or if we want tax-deductible treatment we usually need a valid fiscal receipt from the merchant. This is under USD threshold so fine. Keep the backup in case AP requests it for local tax purposes.
María Gomez: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Should I expect reimbursement on the same payroll or as separate AP payment?
Alex K.: Reimbursements paid via expense run (next Tuesday). If you need faster payment we can do manual AP but need justification — ping me.
María Gomez: All good with next Tuesday. Closing thread. :smile:
